description: The graph illustrates the performance of two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, in reducing the missing step rate across four evaluation steps, with the y-axis representing the missing step rate on a scale from 0.845 to 0.860. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and ranges from 0 to 4, with labeled tick marks at each integer. The 0-CoT method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at a missing step rate of approximately 0.859 at Step 0 and decreasing steadily to about 0.844 at Step 4. The CoRe method is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starting at a slightly lower rate of approximately 0.858 at Step 0 and decreasing to about 0.847 at Step 4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend, indicating improved performance over the steps, with CoRe maintaining a lower missing step rate than 0-CoT throughout the evaluation.
